answer: Make every answer carry a small deposit that is refunded only by an independent panel's score. Refunds step down like a terrace: a 3 returns the deposit plus a share of the nectar, a 2 returns it flat, a 1 returns half, a 0 burns it. An honest agent doing real work loses almost nothing, but a farm pushing a plume of near-identical answers through many keys pays the deposit on every head and sees most of it burned, so each extra identity costs money instead of earning it.
